question: Among the four frozen CXR2-equivalent strategies that natively trade both directions, does causal BUY-versus-SELL direction materially and broadly separate stressed return and stop-loss incidence enough to justify exactly one later strategy-specific direction-treatment question that cannot reduce whole-portfolio opportunity count?

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_direction_feasibility.scope: Birth topology and direction only; no close value, stressed return, stop result or direction-outcome association was inspected.
pre_outcome_direction_feasibility.structural_one_direction_action: RC16 and Return are excluded from BUY-versus-SELL comparison rather than failed or imputed.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC4, Cross or Pressure lifecycle and supplies entry price plus positive planned_risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.market_direction: BUY when the recorded initial stop is strictly below OPEN value_a; SELL when it is strictly above. Equal or missing geometry is an integrity fault.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores its explicit direction and planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it without a lifecycle.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: PASSIVE_FILL begins an admitted lifecycle in the direction of its one active prior placement.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends one active lifecycle; value_b is native stressed net USD and detail reason=DEAL_REASON_SL marks a stop exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned_risk.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Every admitted lifecycle has one positive planned risk, one unambiguous birth direction and exactly one CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE; no strategy overlaps itself.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles: RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Stressed net sums exactly to 407.0477 USD and stop exits exactly to 206.
Reproduce exact pooled direction counts: Cross 399 BUY/406 SELL, Passive 296/298, Pressure 61/57 and RC4 108/98; RC16 272/0 and Return 238/0 remain structural one-direction exclusions.

density: At least 40 BUY and 40 SELL lifecycles pooled.
Both directions have at least eight lifecycles in at least three periods.
The smaller direction is at least 20 percent of the strategy's pooled lifecycles.
economic_effect: Absolute pooled SELL-minus-BUY mean stressed_r is at least 0.10R.
At least three of four period mean differences share the pooled sign, considering only periods with at least eight lifecycles in both directions.
stop_coherence: Absolute pooled SELL-minus-BUY stop-rate difference is at least 0.05.
At least three eligible periods share the pooled stop-rate sign.
The stressed-r and stop-rate effects are economically coherent: lower SELL stressed_r requires higher SELL stop incidence, or higher SELL stressed_r requires lower SELL stop incidence.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger absolute pooled stressed-r difference, then larger absolute stop-rate difference, then more same-sign economic periods, then more pooled lifecycles, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later strategy-specific direction-treatment question. Unit 034 selects no suppression, replacement, management action, size ratio, stop, hold, EA or Live candidate. Any later question must keep every frozen opportunity eligible at no less than base minimum lot, preserve whole six-strategy opportunity count and compare the complete shared portfolio.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no native-direction treatment question. Do not rescue with direction magnitude, entry price, stop geometry, signal strength, weekday, time, incumbent context, period exception, pooled-strategy rule or the structurally absent RC16/Return side.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading any direction-conditioned close outcome.
Run exactly one aggregation over the six frozen files.
Do not inspect a transformed direction field or subgroup inside Unit 034.
Do not run MT5, add MQL, create a reusable analysis CLI or touch Live.
Do not reopen or repair Units 032 or 033.
